events.title: Overwrite Conflict Is in Steam Next Fest. Play the Free Demo Now!
events.summary: Hello, Commanders!Overwrite Conflict is officially part of Steam Next Fest (October 19–26)! The free demo is available now. Come try a deckbuilder where it’s not just about which card to play, but where to place it.What Is Overwrite Conflict?Overwrite Conflict combines shape placement with turn-based roguelike deckbuilding.Rotate protocols and fight for every cell: Every protocol has its own shape.
